doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Upcoming dates and working overseas
summary: He plans London dates, works with local bands abroad who play good jazz and blues.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: That’s fantastic. What’s in the future for you? You’ve got Van Morrison coming up.
I’m going to England on the 5th of next month. I’m going to London for two dates.
When you go overseas, do you take musicians with you?
You work with a band over there?
In fact it’s singing to the beat. No, it’s hard sometimes, but I get along.
People, maybe their concept is a little bit different?
